title: Forearm Kneading
summary: The muscular tissue is gently grasped and rhythmically kneaded.
goal: Work the forearm muscles within a comfortable range.
instructions: Grasp it with the palm and fingers.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, inflammation, or impaired sensation.
